page.overview:
Who is Eric Roadales?

Eric Roadales is a minor character in Cars. He is the hauler for the racing team, "Nitroade."

"Shhhh! The Team Nitroade hauler is used to driving Aiken Axler around quietly so the race car can practice his Tai Rod meditation."
